allowed_headline_claims.headline: Exact homogeneous nonperturbative polarized Liouville transport
minimal_conditions: Spatial homogeneity.
Metric signature (-,+,+,+), epsilon_123=+1, and the locked screen/tetrad conventions.
Sufficient regularity for the distribution and angular projections.
Collision scope, when present, is the cold non-tilted electron-rest Thomson block.
allowed_headline_claims.release_text: An exact formula-level Liouville transport theorem for polarized photons on spatially homogeneous Bianchi backgrounds, nonperturbative in the homogeneous anisotropy variables within the declared regularity and convention domain.

allowed_headline_claims.headline: Cold, non-tilted electron-rest Thomson scattering
minimal_conditions: Cold electron distribution.
Electron bulk tilt is zero in the authority frame.
Elastic Thomson limit.
allowed_headline_claims.release_text: An exact multipole representation of classical elastic Thomson scattering for cold, non-tilted electrons at rest in the normal frame.

allowed_headline_claims.headline: Generic all-rank scalar and polarized PSTF hierarchy
